video_caption: In this segment, a bald man with a beard and glasses, wearing a white t-shirt with a black collar, stands against a solid blue background. The screen has a white border resembling a camera viewfinder. At the top, a white rectangle displays "FOOTBALL THERAPY" (English: Football Therapy) in black text. At the bottom, a Twitter logo is shown next to "@FOOTBALLYANNICK".
